Weng.Modeler
Class Model

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--Weng.Modeler.Model
public class Model
extends java.lang.Object

This singleton class serves as a proxy to the modeler database. Use this class to get entities from the modeler database.

Merge the contents of an MM2 file into the modeler.
Parameters:

ox - the X ordinate at which to place the X origin of the model being merged.
oy - the Y ordinate at which to place the Y origin of the model being merged.
oz - the Z ordinate at which to place the Z origin of the model being merged.
